text:
Emma CSM: Quick sync — Suncrest hit repeat 503s overnight and we saw another latency bump this morning. Putting this thread to capture follow-ups and owners. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/suncrest/overview :eyes:

Dan (Suncrest): Yep, still seeing intermittent 503s when we batch imports. Impact: 10-15% of jobs failing, users retrying. Happened 01:35–02:20 UTC and again 08:10 UTC.

Raj Support: Logged as INC-2025-789. Initial triage suggests a request queue overflow on the dedicated pool. I ran a quick tail on the LB and saw a surge of concurrent connections from their import worker.

Zhou SRE: Can you paste the exact error lines and the `nginx` upstream status? Also want the inference runtime logs around 01:30 UTC. Example query I need: `query logs where service="inference" and ts >= 1700000000 and status=503`

Raj Support: Pasting truncated logs below — removed PII.
```
2025-11-06T01:33:12Z inference-1 ERROR 503 upstream_connect_failed client=10.4.2.9 request_id=abc123
2025-11-06T01:33:13Z lb-1 WARN high_conn_count=480 pool=dedicated-suncrest
2025-11-06T01:33:13Z inference-2 ERROR OOM warning mem=15.2GB/16GB request_id=abc124
```

Raj Support: Also saw `502` on the LB for a short window. I increased the request queue size on the pool from 256 -> 512 as a temporary measure (will monitor). :white_check_mark:

Dan (Suncrest): Appreciate the quick patch. We still saw a failure during a larger import at 08:10 UTC after patch — looks like burst concurrency is higher than we reported earlier.

Zhou SRE: I'm taking ownership to verify root cause. Next steps:
- reproduce locally with a synthetic import load
- check model serving memory growth and KV cache pressure
- run perf trace during a controlled load (assigned to Zhou)

Zhou SRE: Can someone grant me a short-lived key for the Suncrest dedicated pool so I can run the load generator? Prefer minimal scope; will revoke after test.

Linda AE: I can coordinate with Suncrest to get you the creds. Dan, can you confirm a maintenance window tomorrow 09:00–10:00 UTC for an isolated load test? We'll throttle to your acceptable impact level.

Dan (Suncrest): 09:00–10:00 UTC works. Keep failures minimal, but yes go ahead.

Emma CSM: Summarizing action items and owners:
- Zhou: run local repro + perf trace during 09:00 test, investigate memory/KV (owner: Zhou SRE)
- Raj: continue monitoring pool, roll back or adjust queue if anomalies (owner: Raj Support)
- Linda: coordinate creds + maintenance window with customer (owner: Linda AE)
- Emma: weekly sync and update CSM notes + renewal risk flag if repeat occurs (owner: Emma CSM)

Emma CSM: Please update INC-2025-789 with progress. I'll send a post-test readout thread after the 09:00 run. Meeting invite sent to Dan and team.

AlertBot: [ALERT] High 5xx rate detected for suncrest-dedicated at 2025-11-06T01:33:00Z — threshold exceeded (5% -> 13%).

Raj Support: Noted — monitoring. If we see >10% again, auto-failover to compatible model variant is on policy; will coordinate if triggered.

Zhou SRE: One more ask — please capture a heap profile if OOM noise persists. Use `heap-snapshot --pid <pid> --out /tmp/heap-suncrest-<ts>.prof` during the test.

Dan (Suncrest): Will have our devs standby to help with auth for the key and watch the job queue. Thanks all.

Emma CSM: Great. Closing the loop for now — next check-in after the 09:00 test. If anything urgent, ping #oncall. :thumbsup:
